visual_review.summary_limitation: First repeat reports no summary for support and coverage; second repeat also has missing summary information. Actual row inputs and output IDs appear for the three selected arms in both views. Full scores require the recorded JSON/API evidence.

known_ui_evidence.separation: This audit does not rerun a browser or assert the public Compare summary has repaired. Backend score availability and UI rendering are separate observations.

limitations: The six selected capability questions repeated twice are not 36 independent questions; this audit validates persistence, not judge truth or population accuracy.

Object-attribute and dataset-row references in per-case scores and source hashes were resolved through refs_read_batch before comparing values; exact serialized JSON differs from ordinary local JSON by design.

Per-case scorer_call_ids returned by eval_results_query may be empty even when scored outputs and linked prediction calls are present; this endpoint alone is not evidence that judge leaf Calls are absent.
Historical remote_sync.verified values remain unchanged; this is a new observation, not a rewrite of the earlier incident.

reference_resolution.method: Read-only refs_read_batch; resolves mode, judge requested model, source hash and diagnostic selected-section fields before comparison.

findings.safe_remedy: Use existing saved local results or read-only latest_only + eval_results_query for verification. Do not replay completed calls merely to repair public Compare rendering; UI summary gap remains observed separately.
